items.summary: A tiny, fully intact Indigenous pot buried for roughly 400 years has left archaeologists wondering why such a usable object was deliberately abandoned. items.title: El Niño set to be 'strongest in living memory', says Met Office
items.summary: Scientists say the growing El Niño weather pattern is an "unprecedented event" and means 2027 is likely to be the world's hottest year on record.

items.summary: Astronomers using JWST have discovered that massive early galaxies contain far more small, faint stars than expected.
